sourceProfile: Redacted local LibreOffice user profile registrymodifications.xcu
privacyPolicy: Managed settings only: excludes history, recovery sessions, identity, paths, hardware identifiers and window geometry. Autosave preferences are included.
windowsNoLogo: scripts/apply-windows-global-nologo.ps1 for install-level Logo=0; windows/file-associations.nologo.json and scripts/apply-windows-nologo-associations.ps1 for per-user file associations; no shortcuts are created.
layout: Native essentials toolbar with 14 common and 3 app-specific actions docked on the left (DockingArea=2), native contextual sidebar on the right, and the native status bar visible at the bottom; horizontal toolbars hidden by default.
